project.name: finance
project.description: Backtesting and forward-projection library for a levered multi-asset portfolio with LEAPS overlay.
project.overview: Spec covers Phase 10 sub-phase G, steps G2 and G3 only. These complete the run_backtest rewrite in portfolio.py: (G2) carved-out LEAPS capital routing (Model B) driven by *_LEAPS keys in target_weights, with monthly-contribution splitting and VIX-based dynamic IV; (G3) drift rebalancing with pro-rata partial LEAPS closes and tax-free net-proceeds reallocation. All logic is pure Python; side effects stay at the I/O edges. Helper primitives (should_rebalance, partial_close_leaps, run_leaps_simulation iv_series) already exist from G-prep and G1; the remaining work is wiring them into the run_backtest loop.

data_schemas.name: PortfolioConfig
data_schemas.description: Specification for a single backtest run. Unchanged in G2/G3 except that target_weights may contain *_LEAPS keys (e.g. 'VTI_LEAPS') that route carved-out capital into a LEAPS simulation.

fields.name: target_weights
fields.description: dict[str, float] of asset -> weight. Keys ending in '_LEAPS' (LEAPS_KEY_SUFFIX) route carved-out capital to LEAPS. Underlying ticker is key.removesuffix('_LEAPS'). Weights sum to 1.0 across all keys (base + LEAPS).

fields.name: monthly_contribution
fields.description: Dollar amount added at each month-end, split between LEAPS and base per leaps_fraction.

fields.name: leaps_config
fields.description: LeapsConfig | None. Carries account_type, iv floor, ltcg_rate. None disables LEAPS.

data_schemas.name: BacktestResult
data_schemas.description: Output of a completed backtest. In G3, leaps_ledger.partial_close_events is populated with all drift-driven partial closes, frozen once at the return boundary.

fields.name: nav_series
fields.description: pd.Series DatetimeIndex -> end-of-day total NAV including base holdings + LEAPS MTM.

fields.name: weight_history
fields.description: pd.DataFrame DatetimeIndex x asset of end-of-day realized weights. Includes a LEAPS column reflecting carved-out MTM value share.

fields.name: return_series
fields.description: pd.Series of daily market return excluding contribution cash flow.

fields.name: leaps_ledger
fields.description: LeapsLedger | None. When present, partial_close_events tuple carries all G3 drift closes.

fields.name: config
fields.description: The PortfolioConfig that produced this result.

data_schemas.name: LeapsPartialCloseEvent
data_schemas.description: Record of a pro-rata partial LEAPS reduction produced during drift rebalancing (G3). Defined in leverage.py; already implemented in sub-phase F. Referenced here as the accumulation element.

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: Execution date of the partial close.

fields.name: net_proceeds
fields.description: MTM of the closed portion, added back to base holdings. No tax deducted.

api_contracts.name: run_backtest
api_contracts.description: Core backtest orchestrator in portfolio.py. G2 adds carved-out LEAPS capital routing via *_LEAPS keys, monthly-contribution splitting, and VIX-based dynamic IV. G3 adds drift-rebalancing with partial LEAPS closes and net-proceeds reallocation. External leaps_ledger parameter is already removed (G1); LEAPS is always initiated internally.

inputs.name: return_data
inputs.description: Daily simple returns for all base (non-LEAPS) assets, plus risk_free_rate Series.

inputs.name: price_data
inputs.description: Absolute asset prices; must contain the LEAPS underlying (e.g. 'VTI'). vol_prices may contain '^VIX' for dynamic IV.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Weights (with optional *_LEAPS keys), contributions, rebalance_rule, leaps_config.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NAV series, weight history, return series, leaps_ledger (with partial_close_events), config.

raises: ValueError: if any base asset in target_weights is absent from return_data.returns
ValueError: if a LEAPS underlying ticker (key without '_LEAPS' suffix) is absent from price_data.prices

api_contracts.name: should_rebalance
api_contracts.description: Pure predicate deciding whether drift rebalancing fires. Already implemented in G-prep; consumed by run_backtest's DRIFT branch in G3. QUARTERLY always returns False (schedule handled by get_rebalance_dates); DRIFT returns True if any |w_i - t_i|/t_i > band for a non-zero target.

inputs.name: current_weights
inputs.description: Realized weights at the check date.

outputs.name: triggered
outputs.description: True if any asset drifted outside its relative band.

api_contracts.name: partial_close_leaps
api_contracts.description: Pure pro-rata reduction of a LEAPS position to a target MTM value. Already implemented in sub-phase F; consumed by run_backtest's drift branch in G3 to trim LEAPS overshoot. No tax applied.

inputs.name: target_value
inputs.description: Desired total MTM after the close.

raises: ValueError: if target_value >= current_mtm (no reduction needed)

api_contracts.name: run_leaps_simulation
api_contracts.description: LEAPS accumulation/roll simulation invoked internally by run_backtest. iv_series parameter (added in G-prep) is fed the raw VIX series in G2 for contract creation and roll pricing, with config.iv as floor.

inputs.name: monthly_contribution_to_leaps
inputs.description: Dollar amount to LEAPS each month = monthly_contribution * leaps_fraction.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: IV floor, LTCG rate, account type.

inputs.name: risk_free_series
inputs.description: Daily annualized RFR for BS pricing at month-ends.

inputs.name: iv_series
inputs.description: Daily VIX (decimal); month-end value overrides config.iv with config.iv as floor.

inputs.name: initial_capital
inputs.description: Carved-out capital deployed on day 1 (first date of price_series) as a single create_leaps_contract, so it participates in subsequent rolls. Default 0.0 (backward compatible). Added in G2 to satisfy F-G2-01.

outputs.name: ledger
outputs.description: Contracts and roll events; partial_close_events empty at this stage.

features.name: Carved-out LEAPS capital routing (Model B)
features.description: On initialization, detect LEAPS keys via LEAPS_KEY_SUFFIX ('_LEAPS'). Carve LEAPS capital out of initial_nav: leaps_capital = initial_nav * sum(target_weights[k] for LEAPS keys). The initial carved-out capital is deployed on day 1 as a single create_leaps_contract on the underlying's first-date spot; run_leaps_simulation then handles subsequent monthly additions and rolls on price_data.prices[underlying]. Base holdings dict contains only non-LEAPS keys, initialized to initial_nav * (1 - leaps_fraction) split by base target weights.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(n) in number of trading days; single pass over the return index. LEAPS simulation is O(m) in month-end dates.
performance_requirements.notes: No nested per-day contract loops beyond live-contract iteration already bounded by O(rolls).

property_based_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Project excludes hypothesis per user directive; invariants covered by explicit deterministic unit tests.

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Project excludes mutmut per user directive.

acceptance_criteria: Given target_weights with a 'VTI_LEAPS': 0.30 key, the sum of initial base holdings equals initial_nav * (1 - 0.30) within 1e-9.

The initial LEAPS carved-out capital deployed on day 1 equals initial_nav * leaps_fraction within 1e-9 (verified via the first contract's cost basis: premium_paid * CONTRACT_MULTIPLIER * n_contracts).
Base holdings dict contains no key ending in '_LEAPS'.
A LEAPS key whose underlying (key without '_LEAPS') is absent from price_data.prices raises ValueError.

test_requirements.description: Base holdings sum == initial_nav * (1 - leaps_fraction) for a single LEAPS key config.
ValueError raised when more than one distinct LEAPS underlying is present (single-underlying limitation: BacktestResult carries one leaps_ledger).
ValueError raised when LEAPS underlying missing from price_data.prices.
leaps_fraction == 0 (no LEAPS keys) reproduces pure base-asset backtest behavior (regression against G1 result).
Initial LEAPS contract created on day 1 (first backtest date) with cost basis == initial_nav * leaps_fraction.

edge_cases: leaps_fraction == 1.0 (all capital in LEAPS, empty base holdings dict).
Multiple LEAPS keys with distinct underlyings — raises ValueError (BacktestResult carries a single leaps_ledger).
Both 'VTI' and 'VTI_LEAPS' present in target_weights simultaneously (allowed to coexist).
features.clarification_notes: RESOLVED: initial carved-out capital (initial_nav * leaps_fraction) is deployed on day 1 as a single create_leaps_contract on the first-date spot; run_leaps_simulation handles subsequent monthly additions and rolls.

features.name: Monthly contribution split between LEAPS and base
features.description: At each month-end, split monthly_contribution: leaps_contribution = monthly_contribution * leaps_fraction routed to new LEAPS contracts (via run_leaps_simulation's monthly purchase), base_contribution = monthly_contribution * (1 - leaps_fraction) allocated across base assets proportional to their normalized base target weights.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(1) per month-end for the split; O(base_assets) for allocation.

acceptance_criteria: The LEAPS monthly contribution passed to run_leaps_simulation equals monthly_contribution * leaps_fraction within 1e-9.
The sum of base-asset contributions at a month-end equals monthly_contribution * (1 - leaps_fraction) within 1e-9.
Base contribution is allocated across base assets in proportion to their normalized base target weights (each asset's share within 1e-9).

test_requirements.description: LEAPS monthly contribution == monthly_contribution * leaps_fraction.
Sum of base contributions == monthly_contribution * (1 - leaps_fraction).
leaps_fraction == 0 routes full contribution to base (regression).

edge_cases: leaps_fraction == 1.0 (entire contribution to LEAPS, zero base contribution).

features.name: VIX-based dynamic implied volatility
features.description: Read '^VIX' from price_data.vol_prices when present. For contract creation and rolling (month-end events), pass the raw VIX series as iv_series to run_leaps_simulation. For daily mark-to-market, use a 30-day rolling mean of VIX (ffill) to reduce noise. In all cases config.leaps_config.iv is the floor: iv = max(vix_value, config.leaps_config.iv). When vol_prices lacks '^VIX' or is empty, fall back to config.leaps_config.iv everywhere.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(n) for the rolling-mean precompute (vectorized pandas .rolling(30).mean().ffill()).
performance_requirements.notes: Rolling mean computed once outside the daily loop, not per-day.

acceptance_criteria: No contract is created or rolled with an IV below config.leaps_config.iv (floor respected) for any month-end date.
Daily MTM IV equals max(rolling_30day_mean_vix(date), config.leaps_config.iv) within 1e-9 when '^VIX' is present.
When price_data.vol_prices is empty or lacks '^VIX', every contract and MTM uses exactly config.leaps_config.iv.
Contract-creation IV uses raw (unsmoothed) VIX while daily MTM uses the 30-day rolling mean — the two paths are verifiably distinct when VIX is volatile.

test_requirements.description: VIX IV floor respected: with a VIX series below the floor, all contracts priced at config.iv.
With VIX above floor, contract-creation IV equals raw VIX month-end value (max with floor).
Empty vol_prices falls back to config.iv (regression against G1).
Daily MTM uses 30-day rolling mean, distinct from raw VIX on a spiky series.

edge_cases: VIX series has NaNs / gaps — forward-filled before use.
VIX series shorter than 30 days — rolling mean produces NaN early; must ffill or fall back to floor.

features.name: Drift rebalancing branch in run_backtest
features.description: For RebalanceRule.DRIFT, check monthly at month_end_dates whether any weight is outside its relative band via should_rebalance(). On trigger, rebalance all assets (base and LEAPS) with no tax and no MIN_HOLD_DAYS guard. For QUARTERLY, get_rebalance_dates() behavior is unchanged.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(months * assets) for drift checks; should_rebalance is O(assets) per check.
performance_requirements.notes: Drift checked monthly, not daily (documented simplification).

acceptance_criteria: A weight drifted beyond +/-10% relative band triggers a rebalance at the next month-end check (post-rebalance weights within band).
No rebalance occurs while all weights remain within the band (weight_history shows no discontinuity attributable to rebalancing).
QUARTERLY rule produces identical rebalance dates and NAV path as G1 (regression, should_rebalance always False).

test_requirements.description: Drift rebalancing triggers at +/-10% relative band breach.
No trigger when all weights within band.
QUARTERLY path unchanged vs G1 (regression).

edge_cases: Weight exactly at the band boundary (strict > comparison, no trigger).
Target weight of zero for an asset (skipped in drift check).
Drift band set very tight causing frequent rebalances (band is configurable constant).

features.name: Pro-rata partial LEAPS close on drift overshoot
features.description: When drift rebalancing fires and the LEAPS position exceeds its target value, reduce the position pro-rata to hit the target MTM by applying a uniform scale factor (scale = target_total_mtm / current_total_mtm) to every live contract via a local scale_map. This applies the same pro-rata reduction formula implemented by partial_close_leaps() but inline, so cumulative closes across multiple drift events compose into one continuation per contract (the flat original->continuation model in _live_contracts supports a single level). net_proceeds (current_total_mtm - target) are added back to base holdings proportional to base target weights (tax-free). If target LEAPS value >= current MTM (undershoot), no close occurs. partial_close_leaps() remains the reference single-contract primitive, covered by its own unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: When LEAPS MTM exceeds target after drift, a partial close reduces LEAPS MTM to the target value within 1e-6 relative tolerance.
net_proceeds from the partial close are added to base holdings with zero tax deduction (sum of base holdings increases by exactly net_proceeds within 1e-9).
net_proceeds are distributed across base assets in proportion to base target weights (each share within 1e-9).
No partial close is attempted when target LEAPS value >= current MTM (partial_close_leaps not called, no ValueError propagates).
With multiple live contracts, each is trimmed to the same scale factor (target_total_mtm / current_total_mtm); post-close per-contract MTM ratios preserve pre-close proportions within 1e-9.

test_requirements.description: net_proceeds added back to base holdings, no tax deduction.
LEAPS MTM reduced to target value on overshoot.
Undershoot case: no partial close, no exception.
net_proceeds distributed proportional to base target weights.
Multiple live contracts closed pro-rata: all trimmed to the same cumulative scale factor; one collapsed partial_close_event per trimmed contract.

edge_cases: Multiple live contracts overshooting — closed pro-rata (same scale factor across all).
LEAPS target value >= current MTM (skip close).
No live LEAPS contracts at drift check (nothing to close).
features.clarification_notes: RESOLVED: overshoot closed pro-rata across all live contracts (uniform scale factor), preserving roll/age distribution; one LeapsPartialCloseEvent per trimmed contract.

features.name: partial_close_events accumulation and freeze at return boundary
features.description: Partial close events generated during the drift-rebalance loop are accumulated in a function-scoped mutable list[LeapsPartialCloseEvent]. At the return boundary, the final ledger is produced once via replace(ledger, partial_close_events=tuple(partial_close_list)). No dataclasses.replace() is called inside the loop (avoids O(n^2) allocations). Mirrors the run_leaps_simulation contracts/roll_events pattern. Implementation: a local scale_map (base contract -> cumulative surviving fraction) tracks pro-rata closes during the loop so daily MTM reflects prior closes without rebuilding the frozen ledger; at the return boundary one LeapsPartialCloseEvent per trimmed contract is built (original=base contract, continuation=replace(c, n_contracts*final_scale)) and the ledger is frozen once via replace(). Repeated closes of the same contract collapse into a single cumulative event.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(number_of_partial_closes) total for accumulation; single tuple() conversion at return. Must not be O(n^2).

acceptance_criteria: result.leaps_ledger.partial_close_events is a tuple (not a list) on the returned BacktestResult.

The number of events in partial_close_events equals the number of distinct base contracts that were trimmed (cumulative closes across multiple drift dates collapse into one event per contract, because _live_contracts maps each original to a single continuation).
The returned LeapsLedger remains frozen (attempting to set an attribute raises FrozenInstanceError).
compute_leaps_nav_contribution / _live_contracts correctly substitute continuation contracts for partially-closed originals from the accumulated events.

test_requirements.description: partial_close_events frozen correctly onto final ledger as a tuple.
Event count equals number of distinct contracts trimmed (collapsed, not per-drift-date).
Full DRIFT backtest with LEAPS: NAV path consistent, continuation contracts honored by _live_contracts.

edge_cases: Zero partial closes over the backtest — partial_close_events == () empty tuple.
QUARTERLY rule — no partial closes accumulated (empty tuple).

risks.description: Initial carved-out LEAPS capital (day-1 lump-sum contract) could double-count with monthly additions or diverge from initial_nav * leaps_fraction if the seed contract and simulation are wired incorrectly.
risks.mitigation: Deploy the day-1 contract exactly once (F-G2-01); assert base_holdings_sum + initial_leaps_cost_basis == initial_nav within tolerance in a test.

risks.description: Mixing raw VIX for creation and 30-day smoothed VIX for MTM can introduce subtle look-ahead or off-by-one alignment bugs against the return index.
risks.mitigation: Precompute both series aligned to the trading index with ffill; assert floor and distinctness in dedicated tests (F-G2-03).

risks.description: Pro-rata partial-close across multiple live contracts must apply a uniform scale factor; an incorrect per-contract split changes the continuation-contract set and downstream MTM.
risks.mitigation: Apply the same scale factor (target_total_mtm / current_total_mtm) to every live contract (F-G3-02); assert preserved proportions in a multi-contract test.

risks.description: Using dataclasses.replace() inside the drift loop would produce O(n^2) throwaway ledger allocations, degrading performance on long backtests.
risks.mitigation: Accumulate events in a local list; single replace() at return boundary. Enforced by acceptance criterion and code review.

risks.description: Tax-free net-proceeds reallocation must not accidentally apply LTCG tax (partial_close_leaps is tax-free by design); a regression could silently reduce base holdings.
risks.mitigation: Assert sum of base holdings increases by exactly net_proceeds (no tax) in F-G3-02 test.

implementation_phases.name: G2 - LEAPS capital routing (Model B) + VIX IV
implementation_phases.description: Carve LEAPS capital out of NAV via *_LEAPS keys, split monthly contributions between LEAPS and base, and thread VIX-based dynamic IV (raw for creation/roll, 30-day mean for daily MTM) with config.iv as floor.

implementation_phases.name: G3 - Drift rebalancing + partial close accumulation
implementation_phases.description: Add DRIFT branch checking should_rebalance() monthly; partially close LEAPS overshoot tax-free and reallocate net_proceeds to base; accumulate partial_close_events in a local list and freeze onto the ledger once at the return boundary.
